patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I stood up in a hot, crowded church and felt hot and sweaty and my vision went gray, then I passed out for a few seconds. I feel totally fine now. It's happened once before, same way.
presentation.triageNote: 20-year-old male who became hot and sweaty with tunnel vision while standing in a crowded church, then fainted for a few seconds. He recovered quickly, is now completely asymptomatic, and has a normal examination.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this reassuring syncope pattern still warrants one screening diagnostic resource: an ECG.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This young adult had a classic situational faint with prodrome and rapid complete recovery.
clinical.acuityReason: The trigger, warmth, sweating, tunnel vision, brief loss of consciousness, and normal current examination are reassuring, but syncope still requires focused cardiac screening.
keyFindings: Prolonged standing in a crowded church
teachingPoints: Exertional syncope, absent prodrome, family history of sudden death, abnormal ECG, chest pain, palpitations, persistent neurologic findings, or bleeding would change risk.
Hydration and recognition of prodromal symptoms can help prevent recurrence.

possibleDiagnoses: Cardiac syncope if screening is abnormal
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A reassuring examination and ECG would allow discharge with hydration, trigger-avoidance, and return guidance.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, looking a bit embarrassed, otherwise fine
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 20-year-old man in nice church clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting up, looking a bit embarrassed. Expression: sheepish but completely well. Clearly visible: a healthy young man with no distress. No text, no logos.
